# ldap_object (Resource)

Manages an LDAP object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ldap_object" "example" {
  dn             = "ou=example,dc=example,dc=com"
  object_classes = ["top", "organizationalUnit"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **dn** (String) Distinguished name of the object.
- **object_classes** (Set of String) Object classes of the object.

### Optional

- **attributes** (Set of Map of String) Attributes of the object.
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import ldap_object.example ou=example,dc=example,dc=com
```
